description:
A new client application for QNAP surveillance system, supporting QVR Pro, QVR Elite and QVP series surveillance appliances.

QVR Pro Client is a new client application for QNAP surveillance system, supporting QVR Pro, QVR Elite and QVP series surveillance appliances. You can browse multiple channels at once, enjoying efficient and easy management of surveillance recordings.
[Important Notes]
- QVR Pro Client installation package is not included in QVR Pro. To install QVR Pro Client, download the latest installation package from the QNAP website: https://www.qnap.com/go/utilities/surveillance
- QVR Smart Client can be used either with an activated CAYIN Media Viewer, CAYIN MediaSign Player, or with a QVR AI Pack license.
[New Features]
- QVR Center Cross-Server Search: Added Face Search, QVR Human, and Smart Search query capabilities when logged into QVR Center mode. Allows searching across all managed servers simultaneously (previously supported basic video playback/viewing only).
- Camera Grouping: Supports organizing multiple cameras into custom groups for easier categorized viewing and centralized management.
- Group View in QVR Center / Multi-Server Mode: Enables viewing cameras by group tabs in both QVR Center and Multi-Server modes.
- Detection Panel in Multi-Server Mode: Added real-time display of detection data for Face Search, QVR Human, and Metadata Search in the right-side panel.
- Native Camera Settings: Supports adding, editing, and deleting cameras directly within QVR Client without switching to the QVR server web interface.
- QVR Human Area Stay Tasks: Added the "Area Stay" task type to detect events where individuals remain in a specified area longer than the set time threshold.
- QVR Face Region Dewarp Support: Supports live viewing and displaying face recognition results for fisheye camera regions configured with region dewarping.
- Multi-E-Map Camera Placement: Removed the single-map restriction, allowing the same camera to be deployed across multiple E-Maps simultaneously.
- Dedicated Timeline for Face & Events: Added a timeline view on the Face and Event pages to intuitively browse historical records chronologically.
- AI Agent Control (Beta): Added the "AI Agent Control" page and related features in Settings.
- Usage Data Sharing: Added a "Share Usage Data" toggle in Settings. When enabled, QVR Client periodically uploads anonymous usage statistics to help improve product quality (disabled by default, can be toggled anytime).
- QNAP ID Friend & Organization Device Integration: When logged in with a QNAP ID, the device list displays "Friend's Devices" and "Organization Devices" categories for direct connection to authorized devices.
[Enhancements]
- Redesigned Login & Server Management: Re-architected the login page and server management workflow, integrating server addition, editing, and group settings into a unified flow with login history and auto-login options.
- Enhanced Connection Status Display (QVR Center / Multi-Server Mode): Aligned server list status displays with QVR Center specifications. Displays corresponding status icons and action options when servers are unavailable (e.g., offline or authentication failure).
- QVR Human Cross-line Counting Overlay: Overlays counter names and current cumulative counts directly on cross-line counting task lines in Live View.
- Automatic Avatar Population for Face Profiles: When creating a Face Profile from a detection log snapshot, the system automatically applies the snapshot as the profile avatar, eliminating manual photo uploads.
- Clickable Tooltips in Advanced Settings: Tooltip icons on advanced settings pages can now be opened via clicks in addition to hovering, facilitating touch device and keyboard operation.
- Enhanced Camera Audio Controls and State Memory: Added audio toggle settings for individual cameras with state memory support, ensuring settings will not reset when switching views or restarting QVR Client. For privacy protection, audio remains disabled by default and can be enabled individually based on your actual needs.
- System Date & Time Display: Displays the current system date and time directly in the Menu Bar.
[Fixed Issues]
- Fixed an issue where closing QVR Client in full screen mode and relaunching/logging in resulted in the UI window failing to appear while the process remained running in the background.
- Fixed frame dropping and stream degradation issues when viewing multiple 4K H.265 channels simultaneously due to improper hardware decoding configurations.
- Fixed an issue where exporting recording files failed for specific camera models (D-Link DCS-4701E, Error code: d1040300).
- Fixed an issue where cross-day QVR Smart Search results in negative UTC offset timezones (e.g., PDT) caused the timeline to get stuck at the UTC midnight anchor and fail to advance to the next day.
- Fixed an issue where cameras from QVR 5.1 (VioStor / VS series) managed servers remained stuck on "Connecting" in the "Cameras" tab when logged in via QVR Center, while the status bar simultaneously displayed "Connected / Recording".
[Known Issues]
- Opening the QVR Surveillance web interface via QVR Client in HD Station may cause certain pages to display improperly (e.g., the Dashboard under Recording Space appearing blank) due to legacy embedded browser component versions. Workaround: Please access QVR Surveillance using a desktop web browser (such as Chrome or Firefox).
